# ImageElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasImageElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasImageElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasImageElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasImageElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Show an image (file, memory, SVG, animation)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasImageElement> CreateImageElement( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasImageElement> CreateImageElement( const std::string& identifier, float w = 0, float h = 0);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasImageElement> CreateImageFromFile( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& imagePath);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasImageElement> CreateImageFromMemory( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::vector<uint8_t>& imageData, [[maybe_unused]] UCImageLoadFormat format = UCImageLoadFormat::Autodetect);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasImageElement> CreateScaledImage( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& imagePath, ImageFitMode fitMode);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasImageElement> CreateClickableImage( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& imagePath, std::function<void()> clickCallback);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasImageElement(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasImageElement(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasImageElement(const std::string& identifier = "ImageElement");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onImageLoaded` | `std::function<void()> onImageLoaded` | _Image loaded_ |
| `onImageLoadFailed` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onImageLoadFailed` | _Image load failed_ |
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | _Click_ |
| `onHoverEnter` | `std::function<void()> onHoverEnter` | The pointer came onto / left the image (a linked picture tells the status line where it goes). |
| `onHoverLeave` | `std::function<void()> onHoverLeave` | _Hover leave_ |
| `onContextMenu` | `std::function<void(const UCEvent&)> onContextMenu` | A right-click on the image: the host shows its menu (a linked picture's Copy link). A right-click never runs onClick. |
| `onImageDragged` | `std::function<void(const Point2Di&)> onImageDragged` | _Image dragged_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetFitMode` | `void SetFitMode(ImageFitMode mode)` |  |
| `SetImagePosition` | `void SetImagePosition(const ImagePosition& position)` | Where the fitted image sits in the element (default: centred). |
| `SetImageRepeat` | `void SetImageRepeat(bool x, bool y)` | Tile the image across (x) and / or down (y) the element - CSS background-repeat. The tiles line up on the one ImageDrawRect places, at the fitted size; one pattern fill draws them all, so a 1-pixel strip repeated across a large box costs the same as one picture. |
| `SetHeightFollowsWidth` | `void SetHeightFollowsWidth(bool follows)` | CSS replaced-element sizing: with a width and no height, the height is the picture's at that width - larger as well as smaller (an HTML &lt;img width="800"&gt; of a 400x200 picture is 800x400). Off by default: the element then only shrinks its height with a narrower width and keeps the picture's own height otherwise. |
| `SetBoxAspectRatio` | `void SetBoxAspectRatio(float widthOverHeight)` | The shape (width / height) the element keeps while its height follows its width, instead of the picture's own; 0, the default, is the picture's. An HTML &lt;img width="101" height="37"&gt; keeps 101:37 when a narrower column shrinks it, rather than getting narrower at its full height - which, drawn with ImageFitMode::Fill, … |
| `SetTintColor` | `void SetTintColor(const Color& color)` | Multiplies the picture's colours by `color`: white, the default, leaves it as it is, (255, 0, 0) keeps only its red. The colour's alpha sets the strength. Drawn with render-context groups (the Cairo context has them); a context without groups draws the picture untinted. |
| `SetMaskColor` | `void SetMaskColor(const Color& color)` | Draws the picture as a mask in `color`: every pixel takes the colour, at the picture's own alpha (times the colour's), so a black line icon shows in the theme's ink - lighter than it is, which a multiplying tint cannot do. Colors::Transparent, the default, draws the picture in its own colours. Wins over SetTintColor. … |
| `SetOpacity` | `void SetOpacity(float alpha)` |  |
| `SetRotation` | `void SetRotation(float degrees)` |  |
| `SetScale` | `void SetScale(float sx, float sy)` |  |
| `SetOffset` | `void SetOffset(float ox, float oy)` |  |
| `SetAnimationEnabled` | `void SetAnimationEnabled(bool enable)` | Animated images auto-play as soon as they are loaded. Call SetAnimationEnabled(false) (before or after loading) to show only the first frame instead. |
| `SetClickable` | `void SetClickable(bool enable)` |  |
| `SetDraggable` | `void SetDraggable(bool enable)` |  |
